title: GitHub as System of Record & Control Plane
summary: Structure agent systems, integrate them into the SDLC, define the planning/execution boundary, configure observability, and right-size human oversight.

rows: All agent changes tracked via branches, commits, PRs
Workflows, permissions, approvals govern what agents can do
Branch protection rules, required status checks
Session logs linked in commit messages
Audit log events for all agent activity

blocks.text: **Key Fact:** Copilot cloud agent commits are **cryptographically signed** — they appear as "Verified" on GitHub. The co-author is the developer who initiated the task, creating an unbreakable accountability chain.
**Exam Tip:** "System of record" = where changes live (branches/PRs/commits). "Control plane" = what governs agent behavior (workflows/permissions/gates). Know both roles and examples of each.
